{
  "phoneNote": "The salon identity is clear, but widely separated hero links push the small photo arrangement toward the bottom of the first screen.",
  "desktopNote": "The arched photos and burgundy palette feel designed, but the oversized four-line headline dominates the hero and weakens its hierarchy.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline to two or three lines; on phone, tighten the gaps around the hero links and bring larger salon imagery higher.",
    "Replace the tall phone opening-hours chart with compact day-and-time rows, and reduce the oversized desktop section headings and padding.",
    "Keep one booking reminder beneath opening hours and one complete contact block, leaving the footer for business and legal information."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop, opening-hours section: the same booking reminder appears twice consecutively.",
    "Phone, contact section and footer: the phone-and-email contact block is repeated."
  ]
}
